notes:
Faster finishes, clearer warnings, and plainer wording throughout.

- Devices are named by what they are (Main Camera, Drone, Audio) instead of numbered slots
- On a fast backup drive, footage checks now run alongside the copy, so a transfer finishes sooner
- A warning if you insert a card whose footage is already backed up under another couple
- SafeStore tells you if uploads stop moving — your backup carries on, and uploads resume on their own
- The way footage is copied and verified is unchanged
